text: Never modify the user's PATH (or other shell profile/environment configuration) without explicit consent; instead present opt-in alternatives (e.g., create a standalone launcher script or shortcuts the user can enable manually).
evidence: A transferable architectural constraint on how the agent may alter user environment configuration (consent-first, offer opt-in alternatives), not an event record; applies broadly to setup/installation flows.
transferableTo: any change touching user profiles (.bashrc, .zshrc, PATH)
